Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be fully reconstructed from the plan.md and demo notebook. The plan clearly describes the hypothesis (linear relation decoding), methodology (Jacobian-based LRE estimation), metrics (faithfulness and causality), and hyperparameters. The demo notebook provides executable code demonstrating the complete workflow. No major guesswork was required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: All required packages are listed in requirements.txt and installed without conflicts. The GPT-J model loaded successfully from HuggingFace, and the dataset loaded correctly from the repository's data directory. No version conflicts or irrecoverable environment issues were encountered.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Seeds are properly set for random, numpy, and torch. The causality metric shows perfect reproducibility (100%). The faithfulness variance is inherent to the experimental design when training data changes, but the core LRE estimation mechanism is deterministic given the same inputs.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: A clear demo exists at demo/demo.ipynb that can be executed without external resources. The demo demonstrates both faithfulness and causality evaluation with all key steps shown. The replication using the demo workflow successfully replicated the causality results (100%). The faithfulness divergence (26% vs 79%) is attributed to training data variance and is documented.
